verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The boundary logic remains conservative for Unicode, PN_LOCAL escapes, and context-dependent prefixed-name punctuation, while genuine delimiter-adjacent typos retain a positive control. The parser-backed tests are non-vacuous, the scan work is bounded against adversarial punctuation runs, and the canary still fails without applying any suggestion. With round 3 also reporting no issues, progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
